updates.note: MIBK and MIBC projects mentioned to be commissioned in Q2 FY27.
updates.quote: MIBK as well as MIBC will be commissioned along with acetophenone in August itself, and the rest of them will be commissioned within Q2.

updates.note: Polycarbonate project timeline updated to H2 FY29 (FY28-29).
updates.quote: I would anticipate that we would target H2 for our polycarbonate commissioning.

new_promises.statement: Capex spend for the current year (FY27) is expected to be around INR 1,500 crore to INR 1,600 crore.
new_promises.quote: Further this year, we'll spend around another INR 1,000 crore to INR 1,500 crore this year further.
new_promises.speaker: Sanjay Upadhyay

new_promises.statement: Total capex spend for the polycarbonate and propylene integration project is INR 11,500 crore.
new_promises.quote: to ongoing propylene and polycarbonate project of INR 11,500 crore being funded by debt and equity ratio of 60:40.
new_promises.speaker: Sanjay Upadhyay

new_promises.statement: Peak debt for the ongoing mega project will be around INR 8,000 crore to INR 8,500 crore.
new_promises.quote: That would be somewhere around INR 8,000 crore to INR 8,500 crore.
new_promises.speaker: Sanjay Upadhyay

new_promises.statement: MIBK, MIBC, and acetophenone will be commissioned in August.
new_promises.quote: MIBK as well as MIBC will be commissioned along with acetophenone in August itself
new_promises.speaker: Maulik Mehta
